reference_sql:
WITH order_totals AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_eur - line_discount_eur) AS order_eur
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT s.store_code, COUNT(*) AS n_orders, AVG(t.order_eur) AS avg_order_eur
FROM order_totals t
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = t.order_id
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_code
alternatives: SELECT s.store_code, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n_orders, SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS avg_order_eur FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id GROUP BY s.store_code

WITH t AS (SELECT order_id, store_code, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS order_eur FROM sales GROUP BY order_id, store_code) SELECT store_code, COUNT(*) AS n_orders, AVG(order_eur) AS avg_order_eur FROM t GROUP BY store_code

solver.query:
WITH order_values AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.store_id, SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price_eur - l.line_discount_eur) AS value_eur
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY o.order_id, o.store_id
)
SELECT s.store_code, COUNT(*) AS n_orders, AVG(ov.value_eur) AS avg_order_eur
FROM order_values ov
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = ov.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_code
